label: Finance & investing
source_note: Widest disagreement of any niche: conservative sources 8-20, tool-vendor sources 28-50. Band spans both. US audience sits upper half.

label: Credit cards & loans
source_note: Highest reported rates on YouTube; Q4 peaks quoted well above this. Few independent confirmations - treat high end sceptically.

label: Insurance & legal
source_note: Small niche, thin sourcing. Consistently reported high but few data points.

label: Business, SaaS & B2B
source_note: High commercial intent audience. Reasonable agreement across sources.

label: Technology & reviews
source_note: Enormous source spread (4-8 vs 18-25). Affiliate income often exceeds ad income here - RPM understates true value.

label: Semiconductor & chip investing
source_note: Sub-niche of finance+tech; no direct data found. Inherited from finance_investing, adjusted down slightly for narrower advertiser pool.

label: Health & medicine
source_note: Monetisation inconsistent - health misinformation policy can trigger review and cut rates unpredictably.

label: Nutrition & diet
source_note: Supplement advertisers pay well. Some claims trigger limited ads.

label: Career & education
source_note: Conservative sources 2.75-5.50, others 7-11. Edtech and job-platform advertisers.

label: Software & how-to tutorials
source_note: Search-driven and evergreen. RPM moderate but traffic is durable and cheap to earn.

label: History & documentary
source_note: Reported 5-12 and 6-14. Audience skews older/affluent; long watch time supports mid-roll density.

label: Science explainers
source_note: Consistent low-to-mid reporting across sources.

label: True crime & mystery
source_note: HIGH LIMITED-ADS RISK: mature themes commonly demonetised, cutting effective rate 50-80%. Strong membership/Patreon conversion offsets this - not captured in RPM.

label: Self improvement & motivation
source_note: High subscribe rates and good sponsorship potential beyond ad revenue.

label: Travel
source_note: Credit card, hotel and booking advertisers. Production cost is the constraint, not RPM.

label: Home repair & DIY
source_note: Limited direct data. Tool and hardware advertisers; strong affiliate potential.

label: Cooking & food
source_note: US recipe channels commonly report 7-10.

label: Crypto & Web3
source_note: Extremely volatile - tracks the crypto ad cycle rather than any stable baseline. Some financial-claims content restricted.

label: News & commentary
source_note: HIGH LIMITED-ADS RISK. Also a content treadmill - no back-catalogue value.

label: Gaming
source_note: Consistently the lowest major niche across every source. Younger audience, saturated market.

label: Entertainment & general
source_note: Low across all sources. Volume-dependent.

label: Kids & family
source_note: COPPA restrictions remove personalised ads entirely. Structurally capped.

label: ASMR & ambient
source_note: Very long watch sessions support mid-rolls; low advertiser competition. Cheapest production of any niche.

label: Unmatched niche
source_note: Global all-niche long-form average. Used when a niche name matches nothing above.
